caption: If the name shows in bold anywhere, that screen is rendering user input as HTML. Swap for and the same spot runs an attacker's code for everyone who views it. That's stored XSS. React escapes text in JSX for you, so the usual culprits are elsewhere: the admin panel someone built with innerHTML, a toast library that accepts HTML, HTML emails, dangerouslySetInnerHTML for "rich" bios. Check the navbar, comments, notifications, the admin dashboard and the welcome email. Fix: render it as text. If you truly need HTML, sanitize it with a library like DOMPurify first. Source: OWASP Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet. For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master #javascript #frontend #reactjs #nodejs #webdevelopment
